newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's top paper votes Olympic team man of year.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's top paper votes Olympic team man of year.

text.p: Nigeria's team to the summer Olympics in Atlanta is the country's "man of the year" for 1996, according to the leading independent newspaper, The Guardian.

"In triumph, they masterfully burnished our jaded image, proclaiming that this was, after all, not just a land of fraudsters and drug runners," wrote Guardian editor Eluem Emeka Izeze on the front page of the paper on New Year's day.

Nigeria made history when it won several medals including the gold medal in soccer, the first by an African nation. The victory helped to polish a national image dented by human rights abuses, lack of democracy, business scams and drug running.
"They put a smile on our faces," said Izeze, adding: "Our men in Atlanta are our man of the year 1996."
